bear-hand-pencil.prompt: EDIT the attached bear paw reference (BEAR DAD's raised paw and sky-blue sleeve). ONE body part plus one pencil: BEAR DAD's right forearm and paw, Seen from DIRECTLY ABOVE (top-down, flat, no perspective), like a paper cut-out lying on a table. The arm comes UP from the BOTTOM edge of the picture: the SKY-BLUE hoodie jacket sleeve (same blue paper and cuff as the reference) runs straight down and is cut off by the bottom edge. The brown paw (same brown paper as the reference) holds a plain unpainted pale-wood pencil the way you write: fingers curled around it, the pencil leaning so its sharpened gray graphite TIP points to the UPPER-LEFT and is the top-left-most point of the whole picture, a small white eraser end at the other side. The pencil is about as long as the paw is wide (pencil length about 1.05 times the paw width). No red anywhere. The paw is about 30% of the picture width, near the top. Arm vertical, centered, long (it fills the height). No body, no head, no paper, no writing. If your image tool offers a transparent background option, turn it on and keep the alpha; otherwise use the plain flat magenta background.

notebook-open.prompt: ONE prop only, no characters: an open paper notebook (a meal diary) lying flat, Seen from DIRECTLY ABOVE (top-down, flat, no perspective), like a paper cut-out lying on a table. Landscape 300:210 (two pages side by side, a soft fold in the middle, no spiral), thin pale sky-blue paper cover edges peeking around the white pages. The RIGHT page has a simple table drawn with thin pale gray-blue lines: FOUR equal horizontal rows filling the page; each row has a small BLANK label box at its left (about one fifth of the row width) and a wide writing area to its right. In the top three rows the writing area holds only a few faint light-gray pencil scribble lines (illegible squiggles, never letters). The BOTTOM (fourth) row is completely EMPTY: two thin pale ruled lines, lots of white space, nothing written. The LEFT page is blank white with a few faint pale ruled lines. No letters, no numbers, no text anywhere. If your image tool offers a transparent background option, turn it on and keep the alpha; otherwise use the plain flat magenta background.

winky-hand.prompt: EDIT the attached Winky paw reference (WINKY's cream front paws). ONE body part only: WINKY's right front leg and paw, Seen from DIRECTLY ABOVE (top-down, flat, no perspective), like a paper cut-out lying on a table. The arm comes DOWN from the TOP edge of the picture: a cream fur foreleg (same cream paper as the reference, no clothes) runs straight down from the top edge (cut off by the top edge) and ends in a small round cream paw lying FLAT, PALM DOWN, three little toe slits at its bottom edge, the same paw shape as the reference. The paw is about 30% of the picture width; its bottom tip about 6% above the bottom edge. Leg vertical, centered, long (it fills the height). No body, no head, no ears, no tail, nothing in the paw. If your image tool offers a transparent background option, turn it on and keep the alpha; otherwise use the plain flat magenta background.

notebook-closed.prompt: The SAME notebook as the attached open notebook picture, now CLOSED, lying flat, Seen from DIRECTLY ABOVE (top-down, flat, no perspective), like a paper cut-out lying on a table. Portrait 150:210. The front cover is the same pale sky-blue paper as the cover edges of the open notebook, with one BLANK white rectangular label panel in the upper middle of the cover (about 60% of the cover width). No letters, no numbers, no text, no spiral. If your image tool offers a transparent background option, turn it on and keep the alpha; otherwise use the plain flat magenta background.

bear-hand-flat.prompt: EDIT the attached bear paw reference (BEAR DAD's raised paw and sky-blue sleeve). ONE body part only: BEAR DAD's right forearm and paw, Seen from DIRECTLY ABOVE (top-down, flat, no perspective), like a paper cut-out lying on a table. The arm comes UP from the BOTTOM edge of the picture: the SKY-BLUE hoodie jacket sleeve (same blue paper and cuff as the reference) runs straight down and is cut off by the bottom edge. At the top of the arm, the brown paw lies FLAT, PALM DOWN, fingers pointing up, four short thick rounded fingers slightly apart, the same brown paper color and rounded shape as the reference paw. The paw is about 30% of the picture width, its fingertips near the top (about 6% from the top edge). The arm is vertical and centered, long (it fills the height). No body, no head, no other paw, nothing in the paw. If your image tool offers a transparent background option, turn it on and keep the alpha; otherwise use the plain flat magenta background.

set-table.prompt: BACKGROUND PLATE, top-down: looking straight down at a plain WHITE paper tabletop that fills the entire frame edge to edge. Clean matte white paper surface with very faint paper fiber; the only other tone is a soft pale blue-gray (#DCE3EC) used for a gentle shadow along the edges and one or two large layered white paper sheets with thin pale blue-gray shadows between layers. It is a white table or desk top: NEVER brown, no wood, no wood grain, no beige, no tablecloth pattern. Nothing on it at all: no objects, no cups, no notebook, no hands, no text, no lines, no numbers.
